funding.value: All PhD projects are eligible for Department, Faculty or University scholarships, and all are awarded competitively. The Department's STFC studentship (fees at the home or international rate plus a UKRI-level stipend) is open to all nationalities.
funding.quote: Please note that all PhD projects are eligible for funding via a variety of scholarships from the Department, the Faculty of Science and Engineering and/or the University; see our funding page for further details. All scholarships are awarded competitively by the relevant postgraduate funding committees.

also.quote: This fully funded studentship is open to all nationalities and is available to postgraduates undertaking research in physics and astronomy.

entry_route.value: For the STFC studentship: a 2:1 UK Master's (or equivalent), or a First-class Bachelor's plus a Master's. A First-class Bachelor's with proven research experience may also be considered.
entry_route.quote: Hold (or be about to obtain) a minimum of a 2:1 class UK Masters honours degree, or international equivalent, or a First Class Bachelor's degree with an additional Master's degree, or international equivalent. Applicants with a First Class Bachelor's degree, or international equivalent, with proven research experience may also be considered.
